description: Decode a JSON Web Token's header and payload without verifying the signature, and report issued-at, not-before and expiry as dates and whether it has expired. The token is not stored. Do not use the result to trust a token. Use to debug auth flows. Example: token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjMiLCJleHAiOjE3OTIyODE2MDB9.sig. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: jwt_decode
title: Decode a JWT
